mapper.insert: insert into mq_message_record( message_id, exchange_name, queue_name, message_body, status, retry_count, error_message, create_time, update_time ) values( #{messageId}, #{exchangeName}, #{queueName}, #{messageBody}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{errorMessage}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select id, message_id, exchange_name, queue_name, message_body, status, retry_count, error_message, create_time, update_time from mq_message_record where message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.update: update mq_message_record set status = 0, retry_count = retry_count + 1, update_time = now() where message_id = #{messageId} and status != 1
update mq_message_record set status = 1, error_message = null, update_time = now() where message_id = #{messageId}
update mq_message_record set status = 2, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = now() where message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.select: select id, message_id, exchange_name, queue_name, message_body, status, retry_count, error_message, create_time, update_time from mq_message_record where status = 2 order by update_time asc limit 50

select id, message_id, exchange_name, queue_name, message_body, status, retry_count, error_message, create_time, update_time from mq_message_record where status = 2 and queue_name like 'routing:%' order by update_time asc, id asc limit #{limit}
select count(1) from mq_message_record where status = 2
